question: What supreme attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together form a great accomplishment.
This great accomplishment can arise for someone.
Such accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
uncertainties: The implied subject of bhavet is not explicitly stated.
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
